# Optimisation using `optim()`

We can also fit a model using the optim() function in R (or similar approaches for maximum likelihood estimation or maximum a posteriori approaches). Here, the optimiser function proposes different parameter values and evaluates the maximum likelihood for each proposal, in order to move along a gradient until it reaches a maximum value. These steps are illustrated below - they look chaotic as the optimiser initially makes large movements but there are then several small steps near the maximum.
